visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Remove while(1) and Spread-Out Arithmetic
visualizerParams.problemDescription: An endless loop with a break and a two-line formula computes the step count. Rewrite it as a function with a normal loop condition and a conditional expression. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Putting the stopping condition in the while header makes the loop's purpose visible at once. The function name explains the result, and the conditional expression shows the two possible moves side by side.
